author: Arbitra
rationale: Every open question carries the answer the planner recommends, why, and the alternatives it weighed, so a person answers by choosing one, and a model of another vendor can be asked the same question without seeing the pick. Observed on a real project (October 2026): 218 of a plan's 227 tasks were done in a day, and the last ten days waited on answers to its blocking questions, given at last in one sitting of options a, b and c.
compatibilityNotes: a question may carry a suggestion; plans without one stay valid
a run pinned at 1.0.0 keeps its schema without suggestions, so its recorded answers replay and its resume asks the same input
